name: Frontal bone
features: Orbital parts forming the roofs of the orbits
clinical: Frontal sinus fractures from forehead impact can involve the frontonasal duct and the anterior cranial fossa.
sexDifferences: Female: a more vertical forehead with frontal bossing, smaller superciliary arches and glabella, and sharper supraorbital margins. Male: a sloping forehead and prominent brow ridges.
